basics.name: James Hofmann (Jim)
basics.label: TechOps Lead / DevOps Engineer
basics.summary: Versatile and accomplished Information Technology professional with over 10 years of experience. Proven track record in leading international teams, managing cloud infrastructure (AWS/Salesforce), automation scripting, database administration, and agile software development.

work.name: Zilliant
work.summary: Led an internationally dispersed team across EU and USA time zones, managing hundreds of Salesforce orgs and an AWS backend of over 500 EC2 servers and 1000+ databases.
highlights: Ran daily standups and served as an Engineering contact point for high-profile customer project resolutions.
Coordinated with executive leadership and stakeholders to ensure proper task prioritization and tool management.
Established procedural Best Practices by compiling infrastructure recommendations from AWS, Red9, and Microsoft.
Provided extensive technical writing, reports, and ensured internal service KPI commitments were met.

work.name: Zilliant
work.summary: Supported a rapidly growing software company through systems administration and cloud infrastructure migration.
highlights: Administrated Rackspace assets including SQL, FTP, Application, DC, File, and Tableau servers.
Utilized modified Agile methodologies to help migrate the core product to a fully SAAS platform on AWS.
Tracked and documented infrastructure projects and Helpdesk tickets using Jira and Confluence.

work.name: Fusion Labs
work.summary: Assisted with legacy migrations and non-profit product implementations.
highlights: Analyzed legacy VB6 WinForms for Blackbaud and engineered replacement .NET web applications.
Co-developed 'GrantedGE' application to target identified market opportunities.
Traveled nationwide to assist non-profit clients with technical implementations and product integrations.

work.name: Fusion Labs
work.summary: Monitored, maintained, and upgraded all Microsoft-related components of core datacenters and network client accounts.
highlights: Provided extensive on-site infrastructure services traveling across coast-to-coast client accounts.

work.name: Fusion Labs
work.summary: Managed multi-site datacenter operations, hardware provisioning, and critical support ticket management.
highlights: Installed, configured, and repaired physical server units (power supplies, RAIDs, cable routing, crash mitigation).
Deployed racks and network-enabled UPS backup units across datacenters.
Managed physical backup tapes and coordinated offsite storage rotations with Iron Mountain.
Handled access control, change management policies, shift summaries, and customer break-fix requests.

work.name: RealPage, Inc.
work.summary: Started in Data Migrations and advanced to Team Lead before joining the implementation team.
highlights: Partnered with Engineering to automate data migration processes, reducing required headcount from 20 to 6 people.
Collaborated with sales departments, remote consultants, trainers, and handled escalations for direct customer support.
Developed a comprehensive Microsoft Project tracking template to improve resource and timeline visibility for the OneSite sales pipeline.

awards.title: People's Choice Award (On-site)
awards.summary: Acknowledged by peers for being creative, supportive, and developing strong working relationships.

awards.title: People's Choice Award (Remote)
awards.summary: Acknowledged by peers for remote collaboration excellence and supportive leadership.
